description: Search the OurAirports dataset (~86,000 airfields) by a text match against name, municipality or ident, optionally narrowed by ISO country code (e.g. "US", "GB") and/or airfield type ("large_airport", "medium_airport", "small_airport", "heliport", "seaplane_base", "balloonport", "closed"). Results default to airfields with scheduled airline service first. Use this to find airfields by partial name/city when you do not already have a code -- ourairports_lookup requires an exact code. Rows beyond `limit` are reported via truncated/total_matching rather than silently dropped -- narrow the query or page with limit/offset to see the rest. A query that matches nothing returns found:false with an explanation, never a silent empty array mistaken for "no such place".

country.description: Optional: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, e.g. "US", "GB", "FR".

limit.description: Max rows to return, 1-100. Default 20. A truncated response carries truncated:true and total_matching.

query.description: Text to match against name, municipality or ident, e.g. "Heathrow" or "Bensalem".

name: ourairports_search
title: Ourairports Search
